kpi.heading: Key numbers
kpi.totalUsersHint: Counts every account that is not deleted or anonymised, whatever its role or status. Includes test accounts (@example.test), so local numbers run high. Not cached: a snapshot taken when the page loaded.
kpi.newUsersHint: Counts accounts that are not deleted or anonymised and were created in the last 7 x 24 hours, measured back from the database clock (not calendar days). Includes test accounts (@example.test). Not cached: a snapshot taken when the page loaded.
kpi.upcomingEventsHint: Counts published, non-deleted events whose earliest occurrence has not started yet. An event already in progress is not counted. Not cached: a snapshot taken when the page loaded.
kpi.rsvpsHint: Counts RSVPs created in the last 7 x 24 hours (database clock, not calendar days), excluding cancelled and deleted ones. Waitlisted and held RSVPs are included, so this can be higher than the number of people who actually have a place. Includes RSVPs by test accounts. Not cached: a snapshot taken when the page loaded.
kpi.postsHint: Counts posts created in the last 7 x 24 hours (database clock, not calendar days) that are visible and not deleted. Hidden and removed posts are excluded. Not cached: a snapshot taken when the page loaded.

sessions.activeHint: Counts sign-in sessions of this account that are neither revoked nor expired right now. It is a live count at the time the page loaded, not a history. One person on a phone and a laptop shows 2. Only the 5 most recent sessions are listed below, so the list can be shorter than this number.

trust.hint: The level is recomputed from signals by a scheduled job; it is not edited by hand.
trust.hostedCountHint: Counts every event this person organised and has not deleted, over the whole life of the account. Drafts are counted here, so it can be higher than the total of the Events hosted list below.
trust.attendedCountHint: Counts RSVPs of this person that an organizer marked as attended. Events with no check-in are not counted, so it can understate real attendance.
trust.noShowCountHint: Counts RSVPs of this person that an organizer marked as no-show. It only covers events where the organizer marked attendance, and a mark by the organizer is a judgement, not proof.

detail.totalHint: The list shows the 10 most recent items. The total counts all items of this kind that you are allowed to see. Drafts and other people's private items are not counted.

kpi.openHint: Counts moderation cases that are open or in review. Merged and closed cases are not counted, and several reports on the same content count as one case. It is a live count at the time the page loaded.
kpi.overdueHint: Counts open or in-review cases whose response deadline has already passed, compared with the current time. The deadline runs on the real clock, 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, not office hours. There are no notifications yet, so nobody is alerted when a case becomes overdue.
kpi.criticalHint: Counts open or in-review cases at the highest severity, which have a 2-hour response deadline. The severity is the current one, so a case a moderator raised or lowered is counted by its new level. There are no notifications yet, so this number is only seen when someone opens the queue.
